updateNotes:
- <indent=4em>Auto-Feeders no longer need to be filled by staff, but can break down.</indent>
- <indent=4em>Auto-Feeders can no longer feed Supplements.</indent>
- <indent=4em>Auto-Feeders can no longer be used to feed animals which "Require Skill".</indent>
- <indent=4em>Added ability to disallow certain items and skill levels on a staff member via their advanced tab.</indent>
- <indent=4em>Click to open an information window a second time will close it. There is a setting to reverse this change in the options menu.</indent>
 - <indent=4em>Tweaked Prestige generation formula so large animals have a higher "base generation chance".</indent>
- <indent=4em>Adding animals of the same type increases the chance but gives diminishing returns.</indent>
- <indent=4em>Added detailed Prestige tooltip when you hover over icon on any animal.</indent>
- <indent=4em>Added ability to click on task bubble to make it "important". Important tasks are done before unimportant ones, but do not overrule role priorities or zones.</indent>
- <indent=4em>Changed "Require Skill" icon to chevrons rather than archery target icon for better clarity.</indent>
- <indent=4em>Task skill level shown in top right of all task bubbles.</indent>
- <indent=4em>Added a more detailed feeding task tooltip which lists animals and amounts when you hover over the task bubble.</indent>
